about.title: About Adhira Flowers
about.intro: We supply fresh flowers, plant arrangements and plant rentals for offices, events and celebrations across the UAE.

sections.heading: What we do
body: Weekly and one-off flower arrangements for reception areas, meeting rooms and events.
Indoor plants, plant fit-outs and monthly plant rentals for workspaces.
Bouquets, flower boxes and wedding florals for birthdays and celebrations.

sections.heading: Who we work with
body: Offices and corporate teams, event organisers, and individuals planning a birthday or a wedding.

sections.heading: Buying for a business
body: We issue VAT invoices, accept purchase order numbers and can arrange recurring deliveries. For larger or regular orders, request a quote and our team will get back to you.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.intro: How and where we deliver your flowers and plants.

sections.heading: Where we deliver
body: We deliver across the UAE: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah and Umm Al Quwain.

sections.heading: Dates and time slots
body: Choose your preferred date and time slot at checkout. Same-day delivery in Dubai is available for orders placed before 2 PM, subject to availability.
After you order, we confirm the delivery details with you.

sections.heading: Your delivery address
body: Please give a complete address and a phone number that will be answered on the day, so our driver can reach you.
If nobody can receive the delivery, contact us as soon as possible.

sections.heading: Delivery charges
body: Any delivery charge is shown at checkout before you pay.

sections.heading: Looking after your flowers
body: Fresh flowers are natural and perishable. Please unpack them on arrival and place them in fresh water.

returns.title: Returns, refunds and deposits
returns.intro: Our policy for fresh flowers, glass vessels and rental plants.

sections.heading: Fresh flowers and plants
body: Because flowers are perishable, we can't accept returns of fresh flowers.
If your order arrives damaged or not as described, contact us as soon as possible, ideally on the day of delivery, with your order number and a photo, and we will put it right.

sections.heading: Cancelling an order
body: You can cancel an order before it is out for delivery by contacting us with your order number. Card payments cancelled in time are refunded to the original card.

sections.heading: Glass vessels
body: When you add a glass vessel to a product, a refundable deposit is charged in addition to the vessel price. The deposit is refunded when the vessel is returned in good condition.

sections.heading: Rental plants
body: Rental plants are charged monthly for the term you choose, plus a refundable deposit. The deposit is refunded when the plants are returned in good condition. Damaged or missing items may be deducted from the deposit.

sections.heading: Refunds
body: Once a refund or deposit return has been processed, we will confirm it to you by email or phone.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How we collect and use your personal information.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: When you order or contact us: your name, email address, phone number, delivery address, and, for business orders, your company name, TRN and purchase order number.
Details of your orders, and any messages you send us.

sections.heading: How we use it
body: To take and deliver your order, issue invoices, contact you about your delivery, answer your enquiries, and meet our legal and accounting obligations.

sections.heading: Who we share it with
body: Only the services we need to run the shop: our payment provider (Stripe) for card payments, our hosting provider (Hostinger), Cloudflare (image hosting), Brevo (email), and delivery services where required.
We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Cookies and browser storage
body: We use only what the site needs to work: your language preference, your sign-in session, and your cart and checkout details, which stay in your own browser.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
body: We keep order records for as long as needed for delivery, accounting and legal requirements.

sections.heading: Your choices
body: You can ask us to show you, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you by contacting us.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: The terms that apply when you order from Adhira Flowers.

sections.heading: Orders
body: Placing an order is a request to buy. We confirm delivery details after you order, and may contact you if an item or date is unavailable.

sections.heading: Prices and VAT
body: Prices are in UAE dirhams (AED) and are shown excluding VAT. VAT is added at checkout and shown before you pay. Refundable deposits are not subject to VAT.

sections.heading: Payment
body: You pay by card (Visa, Mastercard or Apple Pay) at checkout. Payments are processed securely by Stripe; we do not store your card details.

sections.heading: Delivery, cancellations and refunds
body: Our Delivery page and our Returns, refunds and deposits page form part of these terms.

sections.heading: Substitutions
body: Flowers and plants are natural products. If an exact item or vessel is unavailable, we may substitute a similar one of equal or higher value and will tell you where we can.

sections.heading: Business customers
body: We issue VAT invoices for business orders. Please enter your company name, TRN and purchase order number at checkout.

sections.heading: Our responsibility
body: We take care to deliver what you ordered. Nothing in these terms limits any rights you have under UAE law.

sections.heading: Governing law and changes
body: These terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates. We may update them from time to time; the version on this page applies to orders placed while it is published.
